triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER audit_rooms AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.rooms FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_changes()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_changes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  actor uuid;
  reason_text text;
BEGIN
  actor := auth.uid();
  reason_text := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(current_setting('app.price_reason', true), ''),
    'Perubahan harga'
  );

  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'packages' AND TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF OLD.weekday_price IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.weekday_price THEN
      INSERT INTO public.package_price_history(
        package_id,
        old_price,
        new_price,
        price_type,
        reason,
        changed_by
      )
      VALUES (
        NEW.id,
        OLD.weekday_price,
        NEW.weekday_price,
        'weekday',
        reason_text,
        actor
      );
    END IF;

    IF OLD.weekend_price IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.weekend_price THEN
      INSERT INTO public.package_price_history(
        package_id,
        old_price,
        new_price,
        price_type,
        reason,
        changed_by
      )
      VALUES (
        NEW.id,
        OLD.weekend_price,
        NEW.weekend_price,
        'weekend',
        reason_text,
        actor
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_logs(
      user_id,
      action,
      entity_type,
      entity_id,
      description
    )
    VALUES (
      actor,
      'buat',
      TG_TABLE_NAME,
      NEW.id,
      'Data dibuat'
    );
  ELSE
    INSERT INTO public.activity_logs(
      user_id,
      action,
      entity_type,
      entity_id,
      description
    )
    VALUES (
      actor,
      'ubah',
      TG_TABLE_NAME,
      NEW.id,
      'Data diubah'
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER room_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON public.rooms FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_room_transition()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_room_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  allow_ready_override boolean;
begin
  allow_ready_override :=
    coalesce(current_setting('app.room_ready_override', true), '') = 'true';

  if NEW.status <> OLD.status
     and not (
       (OLD.status = 'ready' and NEW.status = 'occupied')
       or (OLD.status = 'occupied' and NEW.status = 'dirty')
       or (OLD.status = 'dirty' and NEW.status = 'cleaning')
       or (OLD.status = 'cleaning' and NEW.status = 'ready')
       or (
         allow_ready_override
         and OLD.status in ('dirty', 'cleaning')
         and NEW.status = 'ready'
       )
     )
  then
    raise exception 'Perubahan status kamar tidak sesuai urutan';
  end if;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER transaction_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.transactions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_transaction_number()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_transaction_number()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN IF NEW.transaction_number <> OLD.transaction_number OR NEW.guest_id <> OLD.guest_id OR NEW.created_by <> OLD.created_by THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Identitas transaksi tidak dapat diubah'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER transaction_identity_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.transactions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_transaction_identity()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_transaction_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
    NEW.created_by := auth.uid();
  END IF;

  -- The trigger is the single insert path. Dropping the historical default
  -- above avoids consuming two sequence values and prevents caller-supplied
  -- numbers from bypassing the Owner-final generator.
  NEW.transaction_number := public.next_transaction_number();

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role = _role) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_operations(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    public.has_role(_user_id, 'owner'::public.app_role)
    or public.has_employee_position(
      _user_id,
      array[
        'receptionist',
        'housekeeping',
        'supervisor',
        'inspector'
      ]::public.employee_position[]
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.next_transaction_number()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  sequence_value bigint;
BEGIN
  sequence_value := nextval('public.owner_transaction_number_seq');
  RETURN format(
    'BTRDTRX-%s',
    CASE
      WHEN sequence_value < 1000000 THEN lpad(sequence_value::text, 6, '0')
      ELSE sequence_value::text
    END
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_finance(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    public.has_role(_user_id, 'owner'::public.app_role)
    or public.has_employee_position(
      _user_id,
      array['supervisor','investor']::public.employee_position[]
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_employee_position(_user_id uuid, _positions employee_position[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    public.has_role(_user_id, 'employee'::public.app_role)
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.employees
      where user_id = _user_id
        and active
        and position = any(_positions)
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_context_valid(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_context_assignment(
    _user_id,
    NULLIF(current_setting('app.finance_training_session_id', true), '')::uuid
  ) IS NOT NULL;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_context_assignment(_user_id uuid, _session_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT a.id
  FROM public.finance_training_assignments a
  WHERE a.trainee_user_id = _user_id
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND public.finance_training_session_is_valid(_user_id, _session_id)
  ORDER BY a.starts_on DESC, a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_context_matches_session(_user_id uuid, _session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT _session_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.finance_training_session_id', true), '')::uuid = _session_id
    AND public.finance_training_context_assignment(_user_id, _session_id) IS NOT NULL;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_current_user_is_restricted()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_is_restricted(auth.uid());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_current_user_can_read_session(_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_session_is_valid(auth.uid(), _session_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_assignment_for(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, trainee_user_id uuid, supervisor_user_id uuid, starts_on date, ends_on date, status text, label text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT a.id, a.trainee_user_id, a.supervisor_user_id,
         a.starts_on, a.ends_on, a.status, a.label
  FROM public.finance_training_assignments a
  WHERE a.trainee_user_id = _user_id
  ORDER BY a.starts_on DESC, a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_is_restricted(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT a.status <> 'PASSED'
      FROM public.finance_training_assignments a
      WHERE a.trainee_user_id = _user_id
      ORDER BY a.starts_on DESC, a.created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_session_is_valid(_user_id uuid, _session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.finance_training_assignments a
    JOIN public.finance_cash_sessions s
      ON s.id = _session_id
     AND s.opened_by = a.supervisor_user_id
     AND s.status = 'OPEN'
    WHERE a.trainee_user_id = _user_id
      AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date BETWEEN a.starts_on AND a.ends_on)
      AND (
        public.has_role(a.supervisor_user_id, 'owner')
        OR public.has_employee_position(
          a.supervisor_user_id,
          ARRAY['supervisor'::public.employee_position]
        )
      )
  );
$function$
